notes.title: Hard Bullet Demo is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/7c944e672ee9e192b3c999fc3635ae4121db2a15.png[/img]
We've been working hard on this new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]VR game [b]Hard Bullet[/b][/url] and now want to gather your feedback.

Shoot, kick, destroy, jump, fly, push, blow up and — most important — have fun in this timekilling unstoppable action game!

Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]Store Page[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival?tab=12]Steam Festival[/url] to get a Demo and start a mess!

[h1]Max Payne and F.E.A.R. -inspired gameplay[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/ff06c242693b888dc4dd10ca75d6988adc4854bc.png[/img]
We always wanted to bring classic PC blockbusters feeling to VR gaming, so expect yourself to jump, slide, do wall jumps and all this in slow motion!

Made with a special attention for dual wielding gunplay so expect various submachine guns, pistols and shotguns. You'll find classic rifles as well.

[h1]Destructions and Physics[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/b7fdf0f691b4d4fefad1099ee3b98d282b4de876.png[/img]
Inspired by genre-defining classic John Woo movies like [b]Hard Boiled, The Killer, Better Tomorrow, Hard Target[/b]

We worked out the best solutions to bring realistic physic destructions and created dozens of unique assets to fill the arenas. Classic locations to mess everything up: offices, warehouses, laboratories.


[h1]Current Demo Limitations[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/404c28e602f4aad36494bcc7113fcdc68655856c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Please, notice, this is only a Demo Beta Test and does not represent the final Hard Bullet experience.  
[*] No tutorial. Working on it.
[*] Weapons: No auto-reloading animations. No customization and limited interactions. Only a few types available.
[*] Enemy AI: Two enemy characters with a very basic intellect.
[*] Interaction: Limited character interaction. Object interaction is turned off.
[*] [b]Gore and dismemberment are turned off. Blood only.[/b]
[*] Realtime lighting and shadows are turned off.
[*] Inventory: Gun holsters are turned off.
[*] Sounds: Most of them are placeholders or not balanced yet.
[*] Grenades and explosions are turned off.
[/list]


[h1]Join our Discord[/h1]

Talk directly to the devs, share your opinion and ideas with us!
[url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Joining Discord[/url] will help you to stay on Beta Test after the Festival.

Probably we'll turn the [b]Hard Bullet Demo[/b] off and will release an updated version after a while.
To stay on the latest Demo build you can join the Beta Test through our [url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord Server[/url].

[h1]Wishlist and Follow us on Steam![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/208d04ca37e1a89ae0f5446221d35143377da41a.gif[/img]
Add Hard Bullet Steam Page to your wishlist so you'll be ready when it comes.

Steam Forums Feedback

Visit Hard Bullet Steam Discussion Forums and share your feedback there with us!


[url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]DISCORD[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/GexagonVR]TWITTER[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]STEAM[/url]

notes.title: Nevrosa: Primal Ritual is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/11a83c023495bbcc46d93c5bd6ccfaec512b6b1d.jpg[/img]
Hello friends, we are happy to announce our biggest game so far — action adventure in open Misty World is launched on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070410/Nevrosa_Primal_Ritual/
[list]
[*] [b]World Exploration.[/b] Travel across vast lands covered with layers of mist, meet unbelievable plant-animal hybrids, that have been ruling this place for centuries, discover gorgeous ruins of vanished civilization and watch breathtaking scenes around you.

[*] [b]Story full of Mysteries.[/b] Story driven adventure as fearless scientist William Conway who finds an unexpected ally in a face of mystic Cursed Cube which possesses great powers.

[*] [b]Dangerous Adventure.[/b] Main resource to control everything — your own blood. Save precious drops for upgrades or load them as ammo into your faithful Vampire Gun.

[*] [b]Realistic Graphics.[/b] Building Primal Ritual exclusively for VR, we worked carefully to improve unique Nevrosa style in all the things around you. Classic horror movies and books like The Mist, The Thing, Hellraiser and even Avatar inspired the design of creatures and atmosphere.

[*] [b]Voice acting and Soundtrack.[/b] New unforgettable themes from talented composer and musician Zakhar Antonov will create a true cinematographic experience. Music reacts according to the game situation. Find out more good music tracks on the records in the Camp to get into the right mood.
[/list]
We want to thank everyone of you who liked our games and what we do in VR. Only because of our great community it is possible to produce new VR content and take you to new worlds. 

See you in the Misty World.
GexagonVR Team.

notes.title: Nevrosa: Spider Song Page Launched!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087970/Nevrosa_Spider_Song

[h1]Add to your wishlist! Release soon![/h1]
In this half-hour story in a small part of the Mist World, you will try some game mechanics and meet some creatures populating Forest zone. Prepare to live through series of unfortunate events that triggered a dangerous journey of Mr. Conway through savage lands of another world.

You will find yourself amid one of the biomes that could be met in the world we are working on. This dark savage forest is full of dangerous creatures. Such tree zones became a home of giant spiders that are much more intelligent than those from our world are.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27922470/dfefd9f8eb141bb2493aff331048e087148859c8.jpg[/img]
[h1]Core features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Story driven fast-paced adventure in unique setting built for VR
[*] Exploration — Travel across forest lands, find ruins and reveal fragments of the beginning story.
[*] Unique Weapon — Take a Vampire Pistol that uses your own blood and find the right balance.
[*] Giant and tiny creatures living their lives and reacting to you.
[*] Cinematographic scenes and breathtaking moments, realistic graphics and high-quality effects.
[*] Customizable Locomotion — choose Teleport or Free and tune it for the best experience.
[*] Symphonic Soundtrack from talented composer and musician Zakhar Antonov reacts to game situations.
[*] More than a hundred different sounds were created to build unique another world atmosphere.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27922470/92f649617b0149617db8c99bc3dec97cef831698.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Support DLC
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27922470/ef8a3f1a595f7f6c591fff6f1292b35682219ed8.png[/img]

We are working hard on Nevrosa: Escape and the game so far looks gorgeous. You will love it!

As things go, we found out that some help from community would be very useful for us.

We prepared three awesome DLCs with different bonuses to the owners. 
If you want to say "Thank you" or "Do it, guys!" — that is the best way to do it:
[list]
[*][url=store.steampowered.com/app/622730/]Support DLC[/url] will keep Nevrosa: Prelude in your library even if you delete the game files.
[*][url=store.steampowered.com/app/622740/]Wallpaper DLC[/url] includes beautiful images from Nevrosa world for your desktop. Plan to update it regularly.
[*][url=store.steampowered.com/app/622750/]3D Print Collectable DLC[/url] includes Support DLC, one Wallpaper set, and files to create a unique artifact from Nevrosa world — the Cube.
[/list]
We are happy that you liked Nevrosa: Prelude, your feedback and videos — that gives us great motivation while making an interesting and unique experience for you.

Thank you all again.

GexagonVR team.

notes.title: Oculus Rift support
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27922470/da06db9330895e2a43ff98d08834ae3407c5ffaa.png[/img]

Hi, Oculus users!

Now you can try Nevrosa: Prelude with Touch controllers.

You'll need some space to play, we recommend to use 1.5x2 meters, but if you have less — not a big deal, but be careful and watch your room scale setup borders!

[list]
[*]Use your legs to walk in the scene.
[*]Press Trigger to interact with objects.
[*]Press B or Y button to open the in-game menu to tune graphics or restart.
[/list]
